integrity_notes: The mathematical result is supported by a complete generator-and-entropy calculation and a reproducible independent stationary-moment checker. Novelty is assessed against specified accessible sources, not certified against all mathematics.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem uses a symmetric four-state jump graph, isotropic thermal diffusion, a rotated positive quadratic trap, finite constant rates, and the even-orientation time-reversal entropy convention; it does not cover interactions or other parity conventions.
title: Geometric-mean dissipation crossover in a four-direction active harmonic trap
